summary: Teaching physical-modelling synth: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. A bank of 32 resonating modes (a string, tube, bar or plate, and everything between) with a material from wood through nylon and glass to metal, struck, plucked or bowed, and anything between, with force, damping and body size, an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for marimbas, plucked strings, glass bowls, bells and bowed or breathy tones, or to learn how modal synthesis works.
use_for: A teaching physical-modelling synth: marimbas, plucked strings, glass bowls and bowed or breathy tones from a material, a mallet-pick-bow exciter morph and a string-tube-bar-plate geometry.

parameters.name: Material
parameters.description: Shifts modal frequency ratios and high-frequency internal damping along a continuum (Wood -> Nylon -> Glass -> Metal).
parameters.how: Shifts modal frequency ratios and high-frequency internal damping along a continuum (Wood -> Nylon -> Glass -> Metal).
parameters.sound: Morphs the resonant body from warm marimba wood to nylon string, glassy crystal, and ringing bronze.

parameters.name: Exciter Mode
parameters.description: Morphs the physical energy source from a momentary strike (0% Mallet), to a sharp pluck (50% Pick), to sustained friction/air (100% Bow/Breath).
parameters.how: Morphs the physical energy source from a momentary strike (0% Mallet), to a sharp pluck (50% Pick), to sustained friction/air (100% Bow/Breath).
parameters.sound: Switches the instrument behavior between struck percussion, plucked strings, and sustained wind/bowed tones.

parameters.name: Strike / Pressure
parameters.description: Controls the hardness of the mallet/pick impulse or the turbulence/velocity of the bow/breath stream.
parameters.how: Controls the hardness of the mallet/pick impulse or the turbulence/velocity of the bow/breath stream.
parameters.sound: Low values sound soft, felt-like, or breathy; high values produce sharp, bright, forceful attacks.

parameters.name: Geometry
parameters.description: Reconfigures the harmonic spacing of the modal filter bank (String -> Open Tube -> Bar -> Hollow Plate).
parameters.how: Reconfigures the harmonic spacing of the modal filter bank (String -> Open Tube -> Bar -> Hollow Plate).
parameters.sound: Alters the acoustic geometry from a 1D string or flute pipe to a 2D metallic plate or drum shell.

parameters.name: Damping
parameters.description: Controls the rate of energy absorption inside the resonator, especially for upper frequency modes.
parameters.how: Controls the rate of energy absorption inside the resonator, especially for upper frequency modes.
parameters.sound: High damping mutes the ring quickly like palm-muted strings; low damping lets notes ring out freely.

parameters.name: Body Size
parameters.description: Shifts the acoustic formant cavity filter attached to the output of the resonator.
parameters.how: Shifts the acoustic formant cavity filter attached to the output of the resonator.
parameters.sound: Scales the perceived acoustic body from a tiny thumb piano or piccolo up to a cello or concert hall marimba.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.
